assessment_objectives.objective: a process exists to contact data subjects.

a process exists to notify affected data subjects of processing changes affecting their Personal Data (PD), including:
 (1) Erasure of PD;
 (2) Remediation of incorrect PD; and/or
 (3) Processing restrictions affecting their PD.
assessment_objectives.scf_defined_parameters: the period required by applicable data protection law, regulation or contract, and no longer than the shortest applicable deadline
